scope: one six-public-prompt correctness smoke of a default-off validation-calibrated low-margin accepted-draft override
activation_predicate: greedy n=1 draft_check, selected token equals draft and raw top1, finite raw top2, raw top1-top2 margin < 0.08
threshold_selection: predeclared once from the completed six-public-prompt inventory; no retuning after this smoke
correctness_gate: All six target output hashes, finish reasons, and 227 completion tokens must match; at least the calibrated code_python_debug event must log exactly once.
stop_gate: Stop on any identity, source, build, workload, output, process, GPU, override-marker, or cleanup mismatch. Do not retune or retry with a different threshold.
claim_boundary: A pass is local public-validation output-hash recovery evidence, not a general or token-ID exactness guarantee.
